probe.script:
echo __MCPROC_JLIST__
pm2 jlist 2>/dev/null; echo "__MCPROC_JLIST_RC__ $?"
echo __MCPROC_CLOCK__
date '+%z' 2>/dev/null
echo __MCPROC_PS__
if command -v ps >/dev/null 2>&1; then ps -eo pid,ppid 2>/dev/null || ps -o pid,ppid 2>/dev/null; else for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do s=$(cat "$p/stat" 2>/dev/null) || continue; r=${s##*) }; set -- $r; echo "${p#/proc/} $2"; done; fi
F=0
echo __MCPROC_TCP__
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1 && T=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null); then printf '%s\n' "$T"; else F=1; echo __MCPROC_PROC__; cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null; fi
echo __MCPROC_UDP__
if [ "$F" = 0 ] && U=$(ss -lunp 2>/dev/null); then printf '%s\n' "$U"; else F=1; echo __MCPROC_PROC__; cat /proc/net/udp /proc/net/udp6 2>/dev/null; fi
echo __MCPROC_FD__
if [ "$F" = 1 ]; then for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do for f in "$p"/fd/*; do l=$(readlink "$f" 2>/dev/null) || continue; case $l in socket:*) i=${l#socket:[}; echo "${p#/proc/} ${i%]}";; esac; done; done; fi
echo __MCPROC_STAT__
echo "CLK $(getconf CLK_TCK 2>/dev/null || echo 100)"
cat /proc/[0-9]*/stat 2>/dev/null | awk '{ i=index($0,") "); split(substr($0,i+2),f," "); print $1, f[2], f[12]+f[13] }'
echo __MCPROC_RSS__
cat /proc/[0-9]*/status 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Pid:/{ p=$2 } /^VmRSS:/{ print p, $2 }'
echo __MCPROC_ARGS__
ps -eo pid=,args= 2>/dev/null || ps -o pid,args 2>/dev/null
echo __MCPROC_DOCKER__
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then timeout 3 docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}' 2>/dev/null; else docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}' 2>/dev/null; fi; fi
echo __MCPROC_MEM__
awk '/^(MemTotal|MemAvailable):/' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null
echo __MCPROC_URL__
